```yaml
name: Update compat-table

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Every Monday at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-compat-table:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Get latest compat-table SHA
        id: new_sha
        run: |
          NEW_SHA=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/compat-table/compat-table.git HEAD | cut -f1)
          echo "sha=$NEW_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get current compat-table SHA
        id: current_sha
        run: |
          CURRENT_SHA=$(jq -r '.dependencies["compat-table"]' tasks/compat_data/package.json | cut -d'#' -f2)
          echo "sha=$CURRENT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update package.json with new SHA
        if: steps.new_sha.outputs.sha != steps.current_sha.outputs.sha
        run: |
          NEW_SHA=${{ steps.new_sha.outputs.sha }}
          jq '.dependencies["compat-table"] = "github:compat-table/compat-table#'"$NEW_SHA"'"' tasks/compat_data/package.json > tmp && mv tmp tasks/compat_data/package.json
        env:
          NEW_SHA: ${{ steps.new_sha.outputs.sha }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.new_sha.outputs.sha != steps.current_sha.outputs.sha
        working-directory: tasks/compat_data
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run init
        if: steps.new_sha.outputs.sha != steps.current_sha.outputs.sha
        working-directory: tasks/compat_data
        run: pnpm run init

      - name: Run build
        if: steps.new_sha.outputs.sha != steps.current_sha.outputs.sha
        working-directory: tasks/compat_data
        run: pnpm run build

      - name: Check for changes
        if: steps.new_sha.outputs.sha != steps.current_sha.outputs.sha
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Configure git
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: chore: update compat-table to ${{ steps.new_sha.outputs.sha }}
          title: chore: update compat-table to latest commit
          body: |
            Updated compat-table from ${{ steps.current_sha.outputs.sha }} to ${{ steps.new_sha.outputs.sha }}.
          branch: update-compat-table-${{ steps.new_sha.outputs.sha }}
          assignees: Boshen
          delete-branch: true
```
